> **How art requests work**
> By default, Lottie, Heidi & Daniel should be assigned to all art requests and the request will be added to [the art project board](https://github.com/orgs/PostHog/projects/65). They will decide who will work on this brief and reassign as needed. You can check the project board for updates if needed.
>
> **Before you file:** you may not need a request at all — [brand.posthog.com](https://brand.posthog.com) has ready-made brand assets (logos, colors, hedgehogs, and crests) you can use yourself.
>
> **Need an update on your request?** Comment on this issue — it's the best place to chase. Comments keep the context with the brief, and the team triages from the board.
>
> If your request is an actual emergency, please share in [#team-graphics channel](https://posthog.slack.com/archives/C0AU440KS6P) and mention Lottie, Heidi, Daniel, and/or Cory.

## Outline
_Avoid being overly prescriptive and instead provide context about what you're trying to convey - i.e. a feeling, reaction, or narrative._
_If it's for an article, share the draft headline and some bullet points of what it's about._
_For editorial team only: Please specify if this is a build mode newsletter hero image/infrogaphic request. And, if so, let us know what you want the hero image text to be._

## Deadline & Priority
_Two weeks notice is the preferred minimum for new briefs — more time is even better. The team gets roughly 25-30 new requests a month, so briefs are rarely picked up the day they land. A one-week turnaround is only possible for actual emergencies — flag those in Slack as described above._

## Technical requirements
_Dimensions, file type etc._

## Additional comments
_Comments but... additional, you know?_
